title: AERO-VIEW
subtitle: 3D ULPIN & Vertical Property Mapping System
description: A 3D mapping platform that visualizes ULPIN land records and vertical property layers. Built with Next.js and CesiumJS on top of PostgreSQL, it turns flat cadastral data into an interactive city-scale model.
imageAlt: Aerial view of city blocks for the AERO-VIEW project

title: Ushodhya Lassi Corner
subtitle: Food · Brand · Website
description: Brand site for a local lassi shop — menu, story and ordering info with a warm, playful identity. Smooth page transitions and a mobile-first layout built for quick loads on any phone.
